market_question: Will Donald Trump win the 2028 Republican presidential nomination?
reasoning: The 22nd Amendment renders Trump ineligible for a third presidential term, and Republican Party rules require nominees to be eligible. Even if he attempted to run, the party would not nominate an ineligible candidate, making the probability of a Yes outcome near zero.
evidence_points: 22nd Amendment limits any person to two presidential terms.
Republican National Committee rules mandate a nominee be constitutionally eligible.
No major party has nominated an ineligible candidate in modern history.
sources_consulted: News analysis on 2028 eligibility (e.g., Politifact, Ballotpedia)
